facts.claim: Bro. Saunders was elected Worshipful Master for the coming year with Wor. Bro. Carrs as Treasurer.
facts.quote: Bro. Saunders (no connection of the District Grand Master) was elected Worshipful Master for the coming year with Wor. Bro. Carrs, as Treasurer.
